## Director’s Slate Video Studio

- Open Video to generate a clip on a photographic clapperboard. Choose a starting image or describe a scene, then set the frame, duration and sampling.
- Play the result and save an MP4 from the field monitor. An empty library includes a labeled, playable sample.
- Recent clips use stills from each saved video. Select a take to play it. On narrow windows the slate and monitor stack.

The packaged Windows build generated a one-second shot from a selected image in 59.1 seconds. Its preview, history thumbnail, playback, keyboard focus, damaged-draft recovery and verified export passed. The page was checked at 1568 × 1003, 1280 × 720 and 960 × 680. Regression results included seven UI checks, 26 native cases, 11 media cases and two image tests. Two native fixture writers were skipped.

Source commit 132ce34fbcd588cd214a0a5a8f8f3f03e1eed8ce.
